content:
Evan: deploybot blocked promote for release/2026-03-24 (commit f9e8d7). Staging smoke failed with repeated layer checksum mismatches when pulling images. tagging @rina @corey for decision.
deploybot: Promotion attempt at 1718001111 aborted. Error: pulled blob digest mismatch. Expected sha256:aa11bb got sha256:cc22dd. Job: ci/staging/smoke#211. Full logs: https://ci.internal/ci/211 (internal).

Rina: I saw transient 503s from the registry earlier; some uploads from CI may have been interrupted. There's also a pruner cron that ran ~5m before the publish.

Corey: two quick options: 1) pin to previous prod image (safe, fast), or 2) delay the window 30m to attempt re-publish and mirror sync. What's the tolerance?

Evan: product prefers minimal delay but will accept 30m if it means not pinning. Change window in ~1h but we don't want to risk a failed rollout.

Infra-bot: registry GC schedule: last GC completed at 1718000900. Mirror sync job frequency: every 15m, next run at 1718001960.

Rina: mirror may still have good copies. My plan: pause GC, trigger mirror rehydrate for the affected prefix, then run two fast canaries. If mirror has the blobs we should be green in ~20m.

Corey: agree. If mirror fails, we must pin. Let's set a hard cutoff at +30m. If not resolved, pin to sha256:prod555 and document incident.

Evan: consensus: pause GC and attempt rehydrate. @deploybot put the promote on hold until 1718002911 (30m).

deploybot: Promotion put on hold until 1718002911 per request 'hold-rehydrate-mirror'. Will auto-abort at cutoff.

Rina: pausing GC now and kicking mirror job: `infra mirror rehydrate --prefix app/backend --since 1718000500`. Watching logs.

Corey: also adding a short pre-promote check to deploybot runbook: HEAD check for each blob referenced by manifest and compare digest before promoting. I'll open a PR after this.

Rina: mirror reported 72% rehydrated at 1718001250, 100% at 1718001330. Starting fast canaries.

deploybot: canary runs started: ci/staging/canary#212..213.

Rina: canary#212 passed, canary#213 passed. Running smoke/acceptance.

Evan: smoke passed. Proceeding to promote to prod image sha256:prod555. Sam (release coordinator) please note in release notes: "promotion delayed briefly for registry rehydrate; pinned to last-known-good image due to transient artifact digest mismatch; follow-up infra ticket INFR-4042."

deploybot: Promotion successful. prod now at sha256:prod555. Promotion timestamp: 1718001378.

Corey: filed INFR-4042 with timeline and mitigation tasks: add pre-promote HEAD checks, adjust GC window guard, increase mirror sync priority during publishes. I'll own the PR.

Evan: thanks all. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
